Fixes for sending files to a chat, and for photo backup on iPhone.

More about it, and step-by-step install guides, at https://daveragos.github.io/telegrive/

## Which file to download

- **Mac:** `telegrive-1.2.2-macos.dmg`, for Apple silicon and Intel Macs with macOS 12 or newer. See [Opening it on a Mac](#opening-it-on-a-mac) below.
- **Android, most phones:** `telegrive-1.2.2-arm64-v8a.apk`
- **Android, older phones:** `telegrive-1.2.2-armeabi-v7a.apk`
- **Chromebooks and emulators:** `telegrive-1.2.2-x86_64.apk`
- **iPhone:** `telegrive-1.2.2.ipa`, installed with Sideloadly, SideStore or AltStore and your own Apple Account. Follow the [iPhone guide](https://daveragos.github.io/telegrive/iphone.html); it shows every step.

Each installs over 1.2.1 and keeps your drive and settings. `telegrive-1.2.2.aab` is the same Android app as a bundle for app stores; you don't need it. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists every file's checksum.

## Opening it on a Mac

Open the disk image and drag Telegrive onto Applications. Apple hasn't checked the app, so your Mac won't open it straight away the first time. The quickest way through is to paste this into Terminal and press Return:

```bash
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Telegrive.app
```

Then open Telegrive from Applications. Without Terminal, open it once, click Done, and click Open Anyway in System Settings › Privacy & Security; the [Mac guide](https://daveragos.github.io/telegrive/mac.html) shows each step.

## Fixes

- **Sending files to a chat works whatever order they were uploaded in.** Sending several files to someone could fail with "Message identifiers must be in strictly increasing order" when the order they go in, by name or by date, wasn't the order they went into your drive. They now go, and arrive in the order you chose.
- **Photo backup on iPhone no longer gets stuck.** Backup could stop with a few photos left under Up next and nothing going up until Telegrive was closed and opened again. It now carries on by itself.
- **Photos no longer fail to back up with "can't be opened for reading"** on iPhone. Telegrive was clearing away its copy of a photo while the photo was still waiting to go up.
- **A photo or video that failed to back up on iPhone goes up when you retry it.** One that had failed before could fail again every time.
- On iPhone, the copies Telegrive makes of the photos it sends from your library are deleted once they're sent, so they no longer take up space until the next clean-up.

## Support

Telegrive is free, with no ads. If it's useful to you, you can [send a tip on Jami](https://jami.bio/daveragoose). If something doesn't work, [report a problem](https://github.com/daveragos/telegrive/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
